args.subject: Harbor Health Mercury quote decision
args.body:
Hi Sarah,

For Harbor Health’s Mercury quote, use 63 monthly active developers—not the 180 purchased seats—as the usage measure. Since 63 is above the Pilot band, apply the standard Growth terms.

Do not add a one-off enterprise exception; keep the quote on standard Mercury terms.

Best,
Morgan
